title: Income Annuities Commuted Value Lump Sum: Gross Amount, Tax Withholding and Net Payment
content:
The net payment of a commuted value lump sum on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract is defined by four amounts.

**(1) Gross amount.** The gross amount paid is the commuted value carried on the latest approved commutation election on the contract.

**(2) Taxable part.** Its taxable part is the commuted value less a tax-free part equal to the commuted value multiplied by the exclusion ratio on the contract, rounded to the cent.

**(3) Taxes.** Federal tax is withheld from the taxable part at the rate on the contract's withholding election, rounded to the cent. No state tax is withheld.

**(4) Amount sent.** The amount sent is the commuted value less the federal tax and the state tax, each tax rounded to the cent on its own.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

Latest approved commutation election carrying a commuted value of $68,872.97; exclusion ratio 40%; contract's withholding election 10%.

| Amount | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Tax-free part | $68,872.97 multiplied by 40% is $27,549.188 | $27,549.19 |
| Taxable part | $68,872.97 less $27,549.19 | $41,323.78 |
| Federal tax | $41,323.78 multiplied by 10% is $4,132.378 | $4,132.38 |
| State tax | None | $0.00 |
| Amount sent | $68,872.97 less $4,132.38 | **$64,740.59** |

Where two commutation elections are on file, the gross amount is the commuted value on the latest one that stands approved.
